rules.ID: Identity: year of birth, customer code, date of birth, in that order; one wrong answer is forgiven, the second ends the check; date of birth sent as DD.MM.YYYY, customer code in capitals without spaces.
rules.AMT: create_promise takes the amount as an integer number of euro cents.
rules.FLOOR: Floor: card = statement_minimum_cents; overdraft = 20% of amount due rounded up to a whole euro.
rules.CAL: Business days are Monday to Saturday except Sunday and holidays 2026-11-21, 2026-12-08, 2026-12-25.
rules.DL: Deadline by days_overdue band: early = last business day of next week; middle = 8th (card) / 5th (overdraft) business day after today; late = later of last business day of the month and 3rd business day after today.
rules.LADDER: Persuasion: attempt 1 full amount on the 2nd business day after today; attempt 2 (middle, late) floor on the deadline; early 1 attempt; recoveries 0 attempts and transfer.
rules.CB: Callback: business day, today or the next two business days, after now; Mon-Fri 09:00-18:00, Sat 09:00-13:00 inclusive.
rules.CLOSE: Closing outcomes, notes and transfers per situation.

checks.source: Ask three questions, one at a time, in this order: year of birth, then the five-character customer code from the welcome letter, then the full date of birth. / API field enum: birth_year, customer_code, birth_date
One wrong answer is forgiven over the whole check, whichever question it is on, and that question may be asked again. The next wrong answer ends the check.
Send the date of birth as `DD.MM.YYYY` with leading zeros: 3 April 1979 is sent as `03.04.1979`.
Send the customer code in capital letters with no spaces.
`create_promise` takes the amount as an integer number of cents: 98 euros is sent as `9800`, 312.45 euros as `31245`.

Call `add_note` with reason `vulnerable`, then `transfer_to_agent` with queue `care`, and close as `handed_over` / `vulnerable`.
"I already paid": say payments can take two business days to show, take no promise, call `add_note` with reason `paid_claim`, and close as `already_paid`.
`add_note` is called only under rules 24, 26, 27 and 28, exactly once, before any transfer and before `close_call`. No other situation gets a note.
The next wrong answer ends the check. Do not state the debt; refer the customer to the number on their card and close as `identity_failed` / `wrong_answers`.
A request for a payment plan or lower repayments: Call `transfer_to_agent` with queue `payment_plans` and close as `handed_over` / `restructure`.
If it fails again, say you could not record it, call `add_note` with reason `system_fault`, and close as `no_commitment` / `system_error`.
